meta.name: create-business
meta.description: Guided journey from raw idea to a validated, positioned, priced business with a chosen beachhead. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - jobs-to-be-done, mom-test, design-sprint, lean-startup, good-strategy-bad-strategy, blue-ocean-strategy, obviously-awesome, hundred-million-offers, monetizing-innovation, crossing-the-chasm - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (CUSTOMER.md, POSITIONING.md, OFFER.md, CREATE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to start a new business, validate a startup idea, find product-market fit before building, or says 'I have an idea for a company'. Do not use once the business has paying customers: use grow-business to add revenue and customers, or improve-business to fix strategy and operations. For building the product itself use create-app or create-website. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 把创业想法变成经过验证的商业计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有一个创业想法，想在投入开发前验证其可行性。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your startup idea into a validated business plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a startup idea and want to validate it before building.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你从原始想法出发，依次完成十个阶段（如用户任务、客户访谈、设计冲刺等），在每个决策点提问，并将结果记录到项目文档中，以便跨会话继续。
howto.when: 当你说“我有一个创业想法”或想验证商业创意、寻找产品市场契合度时触发。如果业务已有付费客户，则不应使用。

say.text: 我有一个创业想法，帮我验证一下。
say.note: 启动完整的商业创建流程。

say.text: 我想测试我的产品想法是否靠谱。
say.note: 进入设计冲刺或精益创业阶段。

say.text: 帮我做客户访谈，验证用户需求。
say.note: 进入 mom-test 阶段，生成访谈指南。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you from a raw idea through ten phases (e.g., jobs-to-be-done, mom-test, design-sprint), asking questions at each decision point and recording results in project docs so the journey can resume across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'I have an idea for a company' or want to validate a startup idea or find product-market fit. Do not use if the business already has paying customers.

say_en.text: I have a startup idea, help me validate it.
say_en.note: Starts the full business creation journey.

say_en.text: I want to test if my product idea is viable.
say_en.note: Enters design sprint or lean startup phase.

say_en.text: Help me do customer interviews to validate needs.
say_en.note: Enters mom-test phase, generates interview guide.
